title: Tyler Shough: Jordyn Tyson a "carbon copy" of Chris Olave

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Shough: Jordyn Tyson a "carbon copy" of Chris Olave
sources.description: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough got a new target in the first round of this year's draft when the team took wide receiver Jordyn Tyson, but there was a sense of familiarity once Shough and Tyson began to work together this spring.
